jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility, leading a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive senior leadership experience the candidate does not have. The subject matter is of clear interest, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this role is based in Washington DC with no London or remote-UK option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow level requiring substantial experience, and the development-policy topic is outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at CGD is a senior research position requiring substantial post-qualification experience and an established record, which the candidate (student-assistant / RA background only) does not have. Climate and development policy also falls outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Genetics
jobs.reason: The role's essential requirement is a PhD in cancer research/oncology or biomedical research — an already-completed doctorate the candidate does not hold — which is a hard disqualifier. It is also entirely outside the candidate's field (genetics/genomics editing) and skill set.
jobs.location: Shanghai, Beijing, Madrid, Milan or Pune (Hybrid)

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditors - (Global)
jobs.reason: The role requires demonstrated experience delivering food-safety audits plus appropriate professional qualifications and sector experience (retail, hospitality, seafood, agriculture) — essentials the candidate does not hold. It sits entirely outside all interest zones and is a poor paper fit.

jobs.title: Adjunct Professor (LA.06.3)
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: requires enrolment as a practising Attorney of the High Court (legal qualification/admission the candidate lacks), a PhD, and at least ten years' post-admission experience — a senior professorial role. The candidate meets none of these essentials.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.reason: Senior title requiring several years of Kotlin/Java software-engineering experience, plus mentoring of junior developers — a deep-technical role well beyond the candidate's analysis-level skills and lacking any professional software engineering experience. It fails both the seniority and technical-skills disqualifiers, and is entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Development Consultant - Salesforce
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical Salesforce development role requiring 3-5 years of hands-on programming (Apex, LWC, Visualforce) that far exceeds the candidate's analysis-level Python and would disqualify on both the software-engineering skills gap and the 3+ years of experience. It has no connection to the candidate's research, policy or intelligence interests.

jobs.title: SENIOR LECTURER.2.01 (AC.07.4)
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers apply: the role is a Senior Lecturer requiring enrolment as a practising Attorney of the High Court, six years post-admission experience, and an LLM plus progress toward or a completed PhD. The candidate holds none of these legal or seniority qualifications, and the delict/labour-law focus is outside the core interest areas.

jobs.title: LECTURER,.3.04 (LA.08.4)
jobs.reason: Ineligible — the role requires enrolment on the practising roll of the Legal Practice Council as an Attorney of the High Court, plus an LLM and at least three years' post-admission practising experience, none of which the candidate has. This is a qualified-lawyer academic post far beyond entry level and outside the candidate's core interest areas.

jobs.title: Consultant - Transaction Advisory
jobs.reason: The posting spans Consulting Associate to Director; the junior end could be entry-level, but the work centres on ESG due diligence, commercial/financial risk and sustainability advisory — a substantial skills gap from the candidate's international-law and policy-research profile, with no clear demand for their core strengths. Sustainability/ESG transaction consulting sits outside all three interest zones, and the private-markets orientation makes it a weak, marginal fit even though nothing hard disqualifies it.

jobs.title: Policy & Campaigns Officer
jobs.reason: The role is officer-level (not senior/manager) with essentials the candidate largely meets — evidence-based policy, desk research, and clear writing on human rights, though a strong understanding of the UK Parliamentary/legislative process and campaigning experience is a partial gap the candidate only partly covers. The human-rights and civil-liberties subject matter is strongly aligned with the candidate's core mission, but the UK-domestic political-campaigning tilt sits slightly outside their international-law/atrocity focus, keeping this a solid rather than top application.

jobs.title: Trustee, Civil Liberties Trust
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly voluntary, unpaid trustee board position, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also seeks senior governance, grant-making and property-law experience the candidate lacks, so it fails on both level and pay.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Communications (Structural Biology, Biochemistry, or Biophysics)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in computational/structural biology, biochemistry, biophysics or molecular biology — an essential qualification the candidate does not hold and in a field entirely outside their expertise. The subject matter is also unrelated to any of the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Payroll and Benefits Manager
jobs.reason: Ineligible: a Manager-level role requiring 5+ years of progressive payroll/benefits experience (including 2 years in management), plus deep US payroll-tax and benefits-compliance expertise the candidate does not have. This is an accounting/HR-operations function well outside the candidate's profile and interest zones.
